rule: Exact target pool for the classic Duel Monsters collection: every Monster, Spell and Trap card whose first English TCG printing (NA/EU/OC/worldwide English) is dated 2002-03-08 to 2004-09-29 inclusive. One entry per canonical card identity (canonical Konami passcode); rarities, editions, reprints and alternate artworks never add entries. Alternate-art passwords map to their canonical id in `aliases`. Cards with no printed passcode are listed in `unlinked`: they count toward the total but cannot be matched to owned copies until a catalog id is assigned. Imported from the owner's checklist 'YuGiOh_Duel_Monsters_Collection.xlsx' (generated 2026-10-27 from the YGOJSON aggregate, itself built from YGOPRODeck / Yugipedia / Yaml Yugi). Boundary candidates with unconfirmed dates (Collectible Tins 2004, Tournament Pack 5, Duelist League 5-6) are excluded. Change it only by re-importing the checklist and bumping `version`.
